cohort: The study included 28 alcohol-exposed infants and 28 healthy unexposed infants.
finding: Prenatal alcohol exposure was associated with reduced white matter microstructural integrity, evidenced by lower AD values in the right superior longitudinal fasciculus and altered FA and MD values in the right inferior cerebellar that were linked to abnormal neonatal neurobehaviour.
cross-section timing: Shortly after birth / early in the neonatal period
